messages:
Jamie: Heads up — noticed steady growth in kv_bytes_in_use for a handful of long-context flows over the last 48h. Not just peak, but baseline creeping up.
Leah: Which customer / model? could be normal for >32k windows but still worth checking.
Jamie: Mostly internal load tests + one customer sandbox. Pattern: long chats with lots of topic switches. eviction count also trending up but eviction size distribution looks weird.
Owen: Can you paste the promql you used? I want to correlate with kernel scheduling samples.
Jamie: PromQL I used:
```
sum by_model(rate(kv_eviction_count_total[5m]))
kv_bytes_in_use{env=\"prod\"}
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_fragment_size_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Leah: Hmm fragmentation bucket metrics seem coarse. We only have fragment_size buckets [128,512,2048,8192]. That hides mid-range splits that matter for reuse.
Jamie: Exactly. For these traces we see lots of 1–2KB fragments scattered, but our bucket jumps to 2k and then 8k. Reuse looks lower for 1.5k fragments.
Owen: From profiler sampling on the runtime, frequent small allocations align with repeated short turns building new KV pages rather than reusing existing ones. Kernel selection sometimes pins small sequences to different kernels causing memory scatter.
metrics-bot: alert: KV_EVICTION_RATE_HIGH fired in cluster-us-east-1 for service/runtime on 1769991005
Leah: Can infra provide breakdown by eviction_reason and by frag_bucket? Proposal: add labels eviction_reason and frag_bucket to kv_eviction_count_total and kv_bytes_in_use. Frag buckets: tiny(0-512), small(513-2048), medium(2049-8192), large(>8192).
Jamie: I sketched two new PromQL panels we should add:
1) Eviction rate by reason and fragment bucket
```
sum by(eviction_reason,frag_bucket)(rate(kv_eviction_count_total[5m]))
```
2) Residency ratio per bucket (residency = bytes resident / bytes allocated)
```
sum by(frag_bucket)(kv_bytes_resident_total) / sum by(frag_bucket)(kv_bytes_allocated_total)
```
Owen: Also want a heatmap of reuse intervals (time between accesses per frag_id). We can approximate with a histogram metric kv_access_interval_seconds_bucket labeled by frag_bucket.
Jamie: For quick triage dashboard rows: (a) kv_bytes_in_use over time by frag_bucket (stacked area), (b) eviction rate broken by reason, (c) residency ratio gauges per bucket, (d) reuse interval heatmap.
Leah: Minor ask: add a derived panel that shows "unexpected memory growth" flags — compare current 6h slope vs baseline 7d median; if slope > threshold, fire a page to runtime-oncall.
infra-bot: note: rollout of label-change requires coordinated migration. New metric labels must be additive and not cardinality-explosive. Use our suggested 4 frag_bucket values + eviction_reason{age,pressure,compaction}.
Owen: Agree. Also we should emit sample ids for traces (trace_id label) when eviction spikes so we can jump to profiler traces in the dashboard drilldown.
Jamie: I'll open a PR to add the frag_bucket computation in the runtime (simple size-to-bucket map) and emit new labeled metrics and a counter kv_eviction_reason_total{reason,frag_bucket}.
Leah: Can you also include a tiny opt-in sampling flag to include frag_id in metrics for 1% of requests to keep cardinality low?
Jamie: yes, sampling flag in config: `kv_frag_metrics_sampling_rate: 0.01`.
metrics-bot: info: new panel request created: dashboard=\"kv-cache-frag-insights\" by Jamie at 1769991207
Leah: Nice. Timeline: PR this week, flag rollout to staging, collect 48h of data, then merge to prod with 1% sampling and ramp if safe.
Owen: I'll add a profiler job that runs during the 48h window and surfaces kernel selection churn in the dashboard as a small table: {kernel_variant, avg_latency_ms, avg_allocs_per_request}.
Jamie: Posting a short log sample showing eviction reasons from a test run:
```
[2026-03-10T09:12:03Z] eviction=pressure frag_size=1536 reason=pressure frag_id=0x7f2a
[2026-03-10T09:12:03Z] eviction=age frag_size=8192 reason=age frag_id=0x9c13
```
Leah: Looks actionable. Thanks — please @me when the PR is ready and add a link to the dashboard JSON in the PR description.
Jamie: Will do. Next steps: PR # -> staging flag -> 48h collect -> dashboard review -> prod ramp. I'll ping runtime-oncall if the new flag triggers >2% unexpected growth.
Owen: One last thing — add a small unit test for the frag_bucket mapping and a prometheus test that simulates 3 patterns (steady long-context, interactive short contexts, bursty topics) so we can validate panels before roll.
Jamie: Good call. I'll include tests. :thumbsup:
Leah: Thanks team — this should close several blind spots we had in kv observability.
Jamie: Filing follow-up ticket for follow-on work: compactness estimator + eviction cost model.
